name: Fantasy Burger
detailed_description:
COOK LEGENDARY MEALS

Step into your medieval kitchen. Prepare everything from enchanted burgers to bubbling soups and hearty plates of steaming food. Use ingredients to restore mana, stamina, or health: your customers are battle-worn heroes!

Play solo or with your party

Run your tavern alone or team up in co-op mode for 2-8 players. Work together to keep up with the hungry rush. One grills. Another brews. A third plates. Someone desperately tries to calm a bard who ordered "something gluten-free, dairy-free, and life-changing."

Serve the kingdom

Meet a colorful cast of guests. Knights, mages, druids, necromancers, and one massive red dragon all take their lunch very seriously. Each visitor has their own tastes and needs. Some want a quick snack. Others need a meal to recharge their stats for the next dungeon.

Travel and discover

Your tavern isn't stuck in one place. Journey across the kingdom, unlocking new regions, rare ingredients, and unique recipes. Impress local rulers, survive picky noble food critics, and earn fame far beyond your starting village.

More than just burgers

Yes, there are burgers, but also soups and hearty full-course meals. You'll pour drinks like magic elixirs and iced brews made from enchanted berries. Fried sides such as mushrooms or onion rings complete the menu. Mix and match to create dishes worthy of epic sagas.

✨ P.S.

Fantasy Burger is the standalone sequel to Galaxy Burger. It brings the same cozy chaos to a brand-new fantasy world. While developing it, we drew inspiration from the fantasy games and stories we grew up with. We're still a small indie team with a big love for food, fun, and dragons. And we hope that shows in every pixel.

supported_languages: English, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese - Brazil, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Turkish, Traditional Chinese

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64bit or later
  • Processor: Intel Core2 Duo 2.4Ghz or Higher / AMD 3Ghz or Higher
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GeForce 8600 GS / ATI Radeon HD 3470
  • DirectX: Version 9.0c
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 750 MB available space
  • Additional Notes: Minimum 1280x720 screen resolution
